items.name: line1_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline (the lines after '...'). Build excitement through the countdown, peak on Russia, then a playful, knowing tone for the China-versus-USA twist. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy. Say every word exactly as written, including 'about'.
lines: Five countries cover about a third of all land on Earth. Can you name them?
